title: Mermaid Pin Rescue
description: Solve 20 handcrafted undersea pin-pulling puzzles—divert sharks and lava while guiding sparkling ocean water safely to reunite the little mermaid.
controls: Tap pins to remove barriers in sequence, neutralize ocean traps, and rescue the mermaid.

zh-CN.title: 美人鱼拔针救援
zh-CN.description: 海底奇幻主题美人鱼拔针救援 20 关：巧妙拉动海宫插销挡住鲨鱼与毒液、放水营救被困美人鱼，关卡精致又烧脑！
zh-CN.controls: 按逻辑顺序点击拔除插销，隔离危险生物并引流清水救出小美人鱼。
